apartment_description: If you decided to come to the big city of Porto to continue your studies, then we have a great place to settle, here in Massarelos! The apartment consists of four charming rooms decorated to meet the students' lifestyle and one of them has a private bathroom. It also has a living room with fireplace, an equipped kitchen where you can prepare your daily meals, and a bathroom. You will be located in a privileged area, close to some shops and restaurants, but more importantly, close to public transport that connects you to the rest of the city as well as to several nearby colleges, such as the Faculty of Sciences of the University of Porto, the Faculty of Pharmacy of the University of Porto and the Faculty of Arts of the University of Porto!
